questions.question: India has won two gold medals at the 45th Chess Olympiad in September 2024. Where did this Chess Olympiad take place?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Budapest, Hungary**__.

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• **The 45th Chess Olympiad was held in Budapest, Hungary.**
 
• India secured gold medals in both the open and women’s categories.
 
• The open team, featuring players like **Arjun Erigaisi and Gukesh D, claimed their first-ever gold**__ after a critical win and China dropping points.
 
• **The women's team, led by Harika Dronavalli, dominated Azerbaijan to secure their victory.**
 
• This achievement marked India's first gold in the open section.
 
• PM Modi praised the teams for their stellar performances on social media.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **__Important Points__**

 
• The Indian men's team won gold after a decisive victory in the final round.
 
• The women's team defeated Azerbaijan to clinch their gold medal.
 
• This historic win is seen as a new chapter in India's sporting history.

questions.question: Where is the Kabaddi World Cup 2025 being hosted?
questions.solution:
The Correct Answer is __**England**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• Kabaddi World Cup 2025 to begin in England.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

 
• The **Kabaddi World Cup 2025** will be hosted in **England**.
 
• The **men's competition** includes **10 teams.**
 
• The **women's competition** will involve **6 teams.**
 
• The competition will last for **7 days** and will be hosted in **Birmingham, Coventry, Walsall,** and **Wolverhampton** in the **West Midlands region** of the UK.
 
• This is the **second edition** of the **Kabaddi World Cup** and the **first** outside of **Asia**.
 
• At the **inaugural edition hosted by Malaysia in 2019**, **India won** both the **men’s and women’s crowns**.
 
• Moreover, this Kabaddi World Cup is different from the one hosted by the International Kabaddi Federation (IKF), whose all editions have been hosted in India.

questions.question: In which sport did Indian player Nitesh Kumar win a gold medal at the Paris Paralympic Games 2024?

__
 
• **Nitesh Kumar** is an Indian para-badminton player.
 
• He won a **gold medal** in badminton at the **Paris Paralympic Games 2024**.
 
• The **Paralympic Games** are a major international multi-sport event involving athletes with a range of disabilities.
 
• **Badminton** was included in the Paralympic Games for the first time in the **Tokyo 2020 Paralympics**.
 
• India has been actively participating and achieving success in **para-badminton** over the years.
 
• Indian para-badminton players have consistently performed well in international tournaments, bringing accolades to the country.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

• **Shooting**__
 __
 
• **Shooting** is another sport where India has excelled in the Paralympic Games.
 
• Indian para-shooters have won several medals in events like air rifle and pistol shooting.

questions.question: Who won the 2024 Men’s Ballon d’Or?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Rodri.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• **Manchester City's midfielder Rodri won the 2024 Men's Ballon d'Or following an impressive season with both his club and the Spanish national team.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• **Rodri was instrumental in Manchester City's fourth consecutive English Premier League title.**
 
• He led Spain to victory at the 2024 Euros, earning the "Player of the Tournament" title.
 
• Rodri finished the season with 14 assists and 10 goals across all competitions.
 
• This win makes Rodri the first Premier League player to win the Ballon d'Or since Cristiano Ronaldo in 2008.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• Vinicius Jr.__

 __
 
• Brazilian forward who plays for Real Madrid, finished second in the 2024 Ballon d'Or race.
 
 
 
• Jude Bellingham__
 __
 
• English midfielder for Real Madrid, secured third place in the 2024 Ballon d'Or rankings.
 
 
 
• Cristiano Ronaldo__
 __
 
• Portuguese star who won the Ballon d'Or in 2008 with Manchester United.
 
 
 
• Ballon d'Or__
 __
 
• An annual football award presented by France Football, honoring the best male and female players in the world.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **Aitana Bonmati won the Women’s Ballon d’Or 2024.**
 
• **Carlo Ancelotti **won Men’s coach of the year.
 
• **Emma Hayes** won Women’s coach of the year.

questions.question: Which country won both the Men’s and Women’s trophies in the inaugural Kho Kho World Cup 2025?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**India.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• **India created history by winning both the Men’s and Women’s trophies in the inaugural edition of the Kho Kho World Cup 2025.**
 
• The matches were held at the **Indira Gandhi Indoor Stadium, New Delhi.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• India’s Women’s team defeated Nepal with a commanding score of 78-40 in the final.
 
• India’s Men’s team also beat Nepal with a score of 54-36 in the final.
 
• The Indian teams showcased aggressive and strategic gameplay throughout the tournament.
 
• Both wins highlighted the collective effort of players and coaching staff, as emphasized by Captain Priyanka Ingle and Coach Sumit Bhatia.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• Kho Kho World Cup__

 __
 
• The inaugural edition of the Kho Kho World Cup was held in 2025 at the Indira Gandhi Indoor Stadium, New Delhi.
 
• It featured competitive matches showcasing the skill and strategy of the participating teams.
 
 
 
• India’s Victory__
 __
 
• Both Indian teams dominated their respective matches against Nepal, displaying excellent teamwork and strategy.
 
• These victories are a testament to the growth and popularity of Kho Kho as a sport in India.
 
 
 
• Key Players and Coaches__
 
 
• Captain Priyanka Ingle credited the victory to the hard work and dedication of players and coaching staff.
 
• Coach Sumit Bhatia praised Nepal’s efforts while highlighting India’s superior strategies.

questions.question: Which team won the Durand Cup 2024 by defeating Mohun Bagan SG 4-3 in a penalty shootout?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**NorthEast United FC**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• **NorthEast United FC won the Durand Cup 2024 by defeating Mohun Bagan Super Giant 4-3 in a penalty shootout at the Salt Lake Stadium, Kolkata.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

 
• Mohun Bagan had a 2-0 lead in the first half with goals from** Jason Cummings (penalty) and Sahal Abdul Samad.**
 
• NorthEast United equalized with goals from** Alaaeddine Ajaraie and Guillermo Fernandez** in the second half.
 
• The match went directly to penalty shootouts after regulation time.
 
• **Gurmeet Singh, NorthEast United’s goalkeeper,** made two crucial saves during the shootout, denying Liston Colaco and Subhasish Bose.
 
• This is **NorthEast United's first Durand Cup** win since their inception 10 years ago.
 
• **Jithin M.S.** was awarded the Golden Ball for providing the most assists in the tournament.
